description: Show which account and workspace this connection operates: signed-in name/email (OAuth only), workspace name, plan, connection type and granted scopes — what this connection may do right now (capabilities: aiSwitches, the owner's switches for AI marketplace publishing, social publishing, bulk price changes and bulk translation, each with allowedNow = switch on AND scope granted; marketplaces, each connected channel with the write directions its owner armed, and for Amazon which stores are open for listing creation, photos/GPSR, and price and stock) — so check it before a write instead of learning from a refusal — and the server itself: its version and every tool it has now (server.tools), with how to refresh an AI app whose tool list is older (server.refreshHint). Call this when the user asks 'which account or workspace am I connected to?', and when the user asks for something your tool list has no tool for: if server.tools has it, your list is outdated — relay server.refreshHint instead of saying Obriym cannot do it. Sign-in connections can use list_workspaces and select_workspace to see or change the bound workspace.
name: get_workspace_info
title: Get workspace info
